title: PIPESHARE Desktop download page upgrade
description:
The public Windows download page at pipeshare.live/download-desktop.html is rebuilt as a brand-first marketing page: PIPESHARE hero, interactive module demos (PipeShare, PipeSync, Plan View, AUTOSYNC), feature highlights for full project upload / DB3 ingest / offline field work / auto-update, and generated demo screenshots.

Download buttons and the latest.yml update-feed wiring are unchanged. Setup still auto-updates from /desktop-updates/; Portable remains a one-shot .exe.

Who is affected: Anyone using the BASE download URL (pipeshare.live). SaaS push is not required for this static page unless you also serve it from pipeshare.net the same way.
changeLog: Upgrade download-desktop.html with PIPESHARE brand hero and clear Windows CTA.
Add interactive tab demos for PipeShare, PipeSync, Plan View, and AUTOSYNC.
Feature copy covers full project upload, DB3 ingest, Plan View, PipeSync, offline/field, auto-update.
Keep Setup + Portable links and latest.yml version detection working.
